target_rationale: Predetermined synthetic 30-day capacity plan: planned bound cases times planned case premium. Neither annual gaps, model weights, rankings nor evaluation results are inputs. These are assumptions, not company-approved targets.
crediting_rule: Count only confirmed written-premium credits dated within the horizon and recorded at or before the snapshot cutoff. This synthetic future-window ledger has no such records.

realization_assumptions.documents: Action deadline plus source maximum approval days; synthetic assumption that obtaining the documents restarts the review clock.
realization_assumptions.query: Action deadline plus source maximum approval days plus 2 calendar days.
realization_assumptions.passive_underwriting: Source submit date plus source maximum approval days. An already elapsed estimate is retained as before-horizon evidence, not moved into the window.
realization_assumptions.callback: Action deadline plus 10 calendar days, synthetic sales-to-credit cycle.
realization_assumptions.renewal: Action deadline plus 5 calendar days, synthetic renewal-to-credit cycle.
realization_assumptions.quotation: Action deadline plus 35 calendar days, synthetic quote-to-credit cycle; usually a future opportunity.
realization_assumptions.review: No supported crediting date from a scheduled review alone. Do not invent a realization date.

contribution_rule: In-window source premium times historical conversion rate; renewal clients use historical retention. This is an uncalibrated synthetic coursework estimate, not confirmed revenue.
partition_policy: Only candidates passing the unchanged three gates and having supported in-window realization enter the formal horizon ranking. Later realizations form a separate future_follow_up group; earlier and unknown realizations are separately disclosed, not scored as horizon money.
non_duplication_policy: Each source record ID occurs once per scenario; policy-linked client IDs are disjoint from client-only candidates. Do not sum estimates across scenarios or describe correlated forecasts as guaranteed income.
